If some ranks skip a conditional branch, the autograd graph on those ranks will not include the operations (and thus the gradient reductions) that other ranks perform. This leads to a mismatch: some ranks are waiting for all-reduce on a gradient that other ranks never trigger, causing a hang.

Specifically, DDP uses "gradient reduction buckets" and expects that all ranks participate in the same all-reduce calls.
